SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.account, u.nickname, r.create_time, r.read_at, CASE WHEN r.read_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS read FROM sys_message_recipient r INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
r.message_id = #{query.messageId}
AND (u.account ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND r.read_at IS NOT NULL
AND r.read_at IS NULL
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
